messages.ppt.fixed.label: Fixed version

messages.ppt.fixed.resume: Finish saving the last fixed version
messages.ppt.help.advanced: Use arrow keys to step through slides and Esc to exit presentation mode; exported files save where you choose on this computer.
messages.ppt.help.example-1: Create a deck, outline slides one by one, and preview in presentation mode
messages.ppt.help.example-2: Export a .pptx file or save a fixed version to Artifacts

messages.ppt.help.title: PPT
messages.ppt.help.what: Edit slide decks in your project, pick themes, present full-screen, export PowerPoint files, and save fixed versions.
messages.ppt.more.label: More
messages.ppt.outline.empty-text: Nothing in that text can become a slide
messages.ppt.outline.heading: Outline from text

messages.ppt.outline.no-docs: This project doesn’t have any Pages documents yet
messages.ppt.outline.no-model: Set up a text model first
messages.ppt.page.title: Presentation
messages.ppt.present.bar: ←/→ to change slides · N for speaker notes · Esc to exit
messages.ppt.present.hint: Present full screen: arrow keys change slides, N shows speaker notes, Esc exits
messages.ppt.slide.title: Slide title
messages.ppt.slides.heading: Slides
messages.ppt.cap.artifacts-compare.description: Check whether a saved version in Artifacts matches the current presentation. Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.artifacts-compare.title: Compare saved and current deck
messages.ppt.cap.artifacts-continue.description: Create a new editable presentation from a saved version in Artifacts. The saved version stays unchanged.
messages.ppt.cap.artifacts-continue.title: New deck from saved version
messages.ppt.cap.artifacts-pin.description: Save the current presentation as a new fixed version in Artifacts. You can keep editing the original, and the saved version won’t change.
messages.ppt.cap.artifacts-pin.title: Pin current deck version
messages.ppt.cap.artifacts-preview.description: Turn a saved version of a presentation into a readable preview for Artifacts, the sidebar, or starting a workflow. Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.artifacts-preview.title: Preview presentation
messages.ppt.cap.content-create.description: Create a blank presentation to receive content from later workflow steps.
messages.ppt.cap.content-create.title: Create blank handoff deck
messages.ppt.cap.content-list.description: List presentations available to select and pass along in a workflow. Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.content-list.title: List handoff decks
messages.ppt.cap.content-read.description: Read the content of a selected presentation to pass to the next workflow step. Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.content-read.title: Read handoff deck
messages.ppt.cap.content-receive.description: Write content handed off from an earlier workflow step into a presentation.
messages.ppt.cap.content-receive.title: Receive deck content
messages.ppt.cap.create.description: Create a new presentation in the current project with one blank slide.
messages.ppt.cap.create.title: Create presentation
messages.ppt.cap.delete.description: Permanently delete a presentation in the current project. This can’t be undone, and any unfinished Artifact save must be resolved first.
messages.ppt.cap.delete.title: Delete presentation
messages.ppt.cap.export.description: Export the saved presentation’s full JSON data and file name (not a PowerPoint file). Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.export.title: Export presentation JSON
messages.ppt.cap.files-entries.description: List PPT presentation files for the sidebar’s Files tab. Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.files-entries.title: List presentation files
messages.ppt.cap.get.description: Read a presentation’s slides, color theme, current version, and Artifact status. Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.get.title: Read presentation
messages.ppt.cap.list.description: List all presentations in the current project and check whether AI outline drafting is available. Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.list.title: List presentations
messages.ppt.cap.outline-ai.description: Use the configured text model to organize text or a Pages document into a slide outline. Won’t call the model if the deck already has 40 slides and isn’t replacing them, and saves nothing if the call fails, returns empty, or the deck changes.
messages.ppt.cap.outline-ai.title: Organize outline with AI
messages.ppt.cap.outline-pages.description: List documents from installed document plugins in the current project that you can turn into an outline under your permissions. Returns an empty list with a reason if none are available. Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.outline-pages.title: List documents for outline
messages.ppt.cap.outline.description: Turn notes, Markdown, or a chosen Pages document into slides: main headings title the deck, subheadings split slides, lists become bullets, and quotes become speaker notes (6 bullets per slide without headings). Appends or replaces up to 40 slides locally without calling AI.
messages.ppt.cap.outline.title: Build slides from text
messages.ppt.cap.placement-export.title: Read a presentation to carry
messages.ppt.cap.placement-export.description: Reads one presentation so it can be carried to another place (the personal space or a project).
messages.ppt.cap.placement-put.title: Place a carried presentation
messages.ppt.cap.placement-put.description: Places a presentation brought from another place here: a move keeps it the same one, a copy makes a new one.
messages.ppt.cap.placement-remove.title: Remove a moved presentation
messages.ppt.cap.placement-remove.description: Removes a presentation from here after it moved elsewhere, only while it is still the version that was carried.
messages.ppt.cap.pptx.description: Generate a PowerPoint (.pptx) file from the saved presentation with slide titles, bullet points, speaker notes, and colors for PowerPoint, Keynote, or WPS. Doesn’t include images or charts. Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.pptx.title: Export PowerPoint file
messages.ppt.cap.promote.description: Save the current slides and color theme as a fixed version in Artifacts. You can keep editing the presentation.
messages.ppt.cap.promote.title: Save deck to Artifacts
messages.ppt.cap.search-entries.description: List searchable presentations in batches so search can build and update its index. Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.search-entries.title: List searchable decks
messages.ppt.cap.subject-read.description: Read a presentation’s current content, version, and linked items for explicit reference. Read-only.
messages.ppt.cap.subject-read.title: Read deck details and links
messages.ppt.cap.update.description: Update a presentation’s title, color theme, or slides. Checks the version you read to avoid overwriting other edits.
messages.ppt.cap.update.title: Edit presentation
messages.ppt.permission.actions-delegate.reason: Read text from installed document plugins in the project to generate a slide outline
messages.ppt.permission.artifact-read.reason: Read saved presentation versions for numbering or recovering an unfinished save
messages.ppt.permission.artifact-write.reason: Save presentations as fixed versions in Artifacts
messages.ppt.permission.model-invoke.reason: Call your configured text model when you explicitly ask AI to organize a slide outline
messages.ppt.permission.ppt-read.reason: Read presentations, slides, and color themes in the current project
messages.ppt.permission.ppt-write.reason: Create, edit, or delete presentations, and build or replace slides from an outline
messages.ppt.permission.storage-private.reason: Store the current project’s presentations on this computer
